title: Your Nightly Wine Is Killing Your Abs
hook: The nightly glass of wine is the one people defend the hardest.
body:
Two glasses a night is 14 glasses a week. That's around 1,700 calories, plus seven nights of degraded sleep every week, forever. There is no version of that where you get abs.

And be honest about what the occasion actually is. If you're counting the Wednesday beers as not really drinking because it was only two, you're only counting the times you noticed.

A lot of guys fail to lose their belly fat because they count what they're eating, but not the calories in their beers, their cocktails and their liquor. Those calories count whether you write them down or not.
close: Leave a comment to let me know how many nights a week you have a drink.
